September Dhaka – Rising musicians to serenade Liberation War Museum
2022-09-29T15:00:59+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/music/news/september-dhaka-rising-musicians-serenade-liberation-war-museum-3131036

Karkhana, an organisation of the young musicians, has arranged musical event September Dhaka, which will be held at the Liberation War musician tomorrow. This is their third initiative, as the first and second events were held in September and December in 2021.

"This year's September Dhaka is all about the city of magic, Dhaka. For someone, it's a city of love and for someone, it's a necropolis where they have lost everything. This city is the witness of their every little precious thing. That's why we wanted to tribute this city through our event," said the organisers.

Nazm Anwar, Masha Islam, Hatirpool Sessions, Firoze Jong and Chitropot, among others, will be performing in this year's event, which will start at 4 pm.
